description: Build an OSC Companion-style button surface inside TouchDesigner: an OSC In CHOP listens for button addresses, each button gets a Select CHOP and Null CHOP row, optional target parameters are expression-bound, and an OSC Out CHOP is configured for feedback. A mapping table records label/address/target/mode/feedback for later editing.

buttons.description: Button mappings to create as Select CHOP -> Null CHOP rows.

address.description: Incoming OSC address for the button. If omitted, one is generated from the label.

feedback_channel.description: Optional outgoing OSC feedback channel name for this button.

label.description: Human-readable button label for the mapping table.

mode.description: How the incoming button channel should drive the target parameter.

target.description: Optional TouchDesigner target parameter, written as 'nodePath.parName'.

create_mapping_dat.description: Create/populate a tableDAT listing label, address, target, mode, and feedback.

feedback_host.description: Remote host that receives outgoing OSC feedback.

feedback_port.description: Remote OSC port that receives outgoing feedback.

listen_port.description: Local OSC port for Companion/button input.

name.description: Name of the Companion OSC surface baseCOMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the companion surface baseCOMP is created.

name: connect_companion_surface
title: Connect Companion OSC surface
